issue_context.title: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_ecdh_kdf_md doesn't work when using the FIPS provider
comments: marking as inactive, will be closed at the end of the 3.4 dev cycle barring further input
This is very interesting corner case bug that we should IMO investigate fix for.

It seems that my report #24004 is duplicated with this one.

Should I close mine?

The call to EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_ecdh_kdf_md(pctx, EVP_sha256())) works correctly (i.e. it does a fetch inside ecdh_ecxh.c)
So it is the getter that is the issue (especially if it has code in cms that sets the value to SHA1 if the get returns NULL)

@t8m @nhorman @levitte any thought on this?
I assume this happens because we have an internal libctx for the fips provider, which will not be registered in the base libctx.

Doing EVP_MD_fetch(anything) followed by EVP_MD_free() also populates the map.

Note that EVP_CIPHER will have a similar issue.

Yeah, our "on-demand" fetching has consequences.  Like @slontis says, a workaround is indeed to fetch something known (preferably from the intended provider, see suitable properties) to get the proverbial ball rolling...

review_comments: you cant do that because this is a dynamic pointer that needs to be freed then - the one it does return is constant
